press_references.value: Cumbuca Launches Fast-Track Payments Initiation Access to Brazil’s Booming Financial Services Market

product_launches.description: Cumbuca launched a new proxy payments initiation access service that lets international firms use its Brazilian Central Bank payment initiation license to enter Brazil’s financial services market faster while retaining operational control.

overview_description.description: Provider of a regulatory proxy platform for Brazil's Open Finance and Pix ecosystem. The company enables fintech firms, including international companies entering the Brazilian market and domestic players scaling beyond traditional Banking-as-a-Service arrangements, to access the Brazilian Central Bank's payment initiation and data sharing infrastructure without obtaining their own license. The platform functions as a thin intermediary layer between client infrastructure and the regulated environment, allowing customers to develop using official Open Finance and Central Bank API specifications rather than proprietary abstractions. Services include payment initiation across multiple modalities, transactional and credit data access, and SCR integration, with clients retaining full control over their infrastructure, operational data, and risk policies. The company holds a Payment Institution license as a Payment Initiation Service Provider (PISP) issued by the Central Bank of Brazil.

product.name: Cumbuca Regulatory Proxy
product.description: A layer-7 regulatory proxy that provides companies with direct API access to Brazil’s Pix and Open Finance ecosystems through Cumbuca’s regulated infrastructure.

product.name: Pix Payment Initiation
product.description: API infrastructure for initiating Pix payments through Brazil’s Open Finance network, including one-time, recurring, billing, sweeping, and other supported Pix payment flows.

product.name: Open Finance Data API
product.description: APIs for accessing consented Brazilian financial data, including accounts, cards, credit, investments, and foreign-exchange information through Open Finance.

product.name: SCR Access
product.description: API access to Brazil’s Credit Information System through Open Finance, enabling consented queries, reports, and historical credit information.

product.name: Open Finance Infrastructure Integration Services
product.description: Technical integration services for connecting a company’s infrastructure to Brazilian Pix and Open Finance APIs through Cumbuca’s proxy.

product.name: Open Finance Data MCP
product.description: An MCP connection that lets users connect bank accounts to AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude through Open Finance.
